note: Ninth set (2026-11-12): one-sided and sideways walking commands, for the one-sided values of prompt v11 (right/left objects, torso_roll, head_roll). Written by Claude before any model was run on it. Each command has a check on the one-sided measures of gait_features.features()["_side"] (r_ and l_ values of each side; torso_roll and head_roll in degrees, + toward the character's right): the expression must reach min. The plain walk gives knee ranges 59 and 62 degrees, hand heights within 0.01 arm lengths, torso_roll -1, head_roll -1. legs and arms are the largest left-right difference of the leg or arm measures in units of a clearly visible difference (knee range 10 degrees, foot lift 0.03 leg lengths, toe angle 10 degrees; arm swing 0.1, hand position 0.1 arm lengths, elbow 15 degrees). Targets are 100STYLE style names where one exists; the 100STYLE features average both sides, so they score only the two-sided part. Do not edit after its first run.

checks.legs: max(abs(r_knee_range - l_knee_range) / 10, abs(r_foot_lift - l_foot_lift) / 0.03, abs(r_toe_out - l_toe_out) / 10)
checks.arms: max(abs(r_arm_swing - l_arm_swing) / 0.1, abs(r_hand_forward - l_hand_forward) / 0.1, abs(r_hand_height - l_hand_height) / 0.1, abs(r_hand_out - l_hand_out) / 0.1, abs(r_elbow_bend - l_elbow_bend) / 15)
